distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 29.8273 +/- 0.0153 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 33.53 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.837 (0.820 to 0.855) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 582,335 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.811 (0.771 to 0.851) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5085 +/- 0.8 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5406324138654973824: teff_gspphot 5085.374 K (16th-84th percentiles 5084.5425-5086.242), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5406324138654973824: teff_gspphot 5085.374 K (16th-84th percentiles 5084.5425-5086.242), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
